question: Can unchanged 55-D/2-D imitation -> SAC reliably complete and improve task?
category: formal, previously exposed nominal Human; deterministic repeats are not robustness holdouts
development_split: Expert development uses archived causal teacher and three fixed BC-prefix states; no tuning after gate
heldout_split: Pure-student rollouts exclude teacher execution, dataset reads and expert queries; same exposed nominal case
truth_firewall: Expert accepts only observation(55), reference q/dq/ddq contained therein, phase and elapsed clocks; no plant/env/trajectory/index argument

expert.calibration: causal posture at existing fixed teacher release; no trajectory lookup during query
expert.gate: All 3 exact archived BC prefixes: legal labels, first action certified, positive synchronized progress within next 2s unless already terminal, and complete independent VALID continuation. Nominal expert also VALID.

dagger.qualification: Two consecutive rounds each >=3/3 pure deterministic independent VALID; no teacher execution/intervention
dagger.phase_sampling: 96 samples each phase, with replacement; all difficult states retained
dagger.selection: fixed final-update checkpoint; no offline fit gate; never select using qualification results

sac.replay: all executed DAgger transitions plus successful pure student evaluation transitions; actions are actually executed raw policy commands, never counterfactual expert labels
sac.actor_init: qualified native actor weights; exact deterministic identity verified; fresh critics/targets/optimizers
sac.stable: Previous two NATIVE checkpoints each >=3/3 VALID; otherwise keep .25
sac.success_loss: Two consecutive NATIVE checkpoints <=1/3 VALID: save last good, freeze actor, STOP
sac.comparator: qualified DAgger / fixed hip-leading / CEM / original controller, separate NATIVE and MATCHED; VALID only J_F rank; new best independently replayed at 1e-6 J_F tolerance

exclusions: none; all failures and difficult states retained
